snippet.title: World of Cubes Trailer
snippet.description:
Get the game on iTunes: http://goo.gl/rI7z3I
Get the game on Google Play: https://goo.gl/jeGFmy
Get the game on Amazon Underground: https://goo.gl/gn2dWH
Get the game on Windows Store: https://goo.gl/wKNzUy
Get the game on Mac OS: http://goo.gl/MvzUF0
---------------------
Like us on Facebook: http://goo.gl/gYP7Og
Follow us on Twitter: http://goo.gl/KE5Cns
Join us on Google+: http://goo.gl/Krr5z1
Follow us on Vkontakte: http://goo.gl/oFYLBG
Visit our Forum: http://woc.solverlabs.com/forum
---------------------
Hi all,

long awaited update is finally coming to all Major App Stores: Apple, Amazon, Google Play and even Windows Store! Yay! 

On this video you can see the overview of main features, that were added to new version 2.0! 

Here is a list of HUGE LONG-AWAITED UPDATE. Do not forget to follow us on Twitter and like our page on Facebook to stay in touch with upcoming updates and features: 

- New themed Skin Packs with 24 new skins in every pack. Total of more than 160 skins for Multiplayer and Survival modes!

- New Blocks Texture Pack: MEDIEVAL. You can choose between 2 texture packs in the Options 

- Added in Game Shop. Now you can improve your gaming experience by purchasing various items and features inside the game

- Shop: Now you can resurrect after death in Survival mode!
- Shop: Added ability to buy compass for Survival and Multiplayer modes. You can navigate easily with the compass in the infinite World of the Survival mode
- Shop: Can’t find Diamond or Gold ingots in Survival? Now you can buy them using coins in the Survival mode

- Multicolor Chat feature! Now you can customize the color of all your messages in Multilayer Mode!

- Added ability to change your skin directly in the Multiplayer game without the need to exit to the main screen

- Record your own game play videos in survival or multiplayer modes and share them to the Everyplay community!

- Added “Players List” button to the HUD in the Multiplayer mode
- “Players List” window redesign
- “Players List”: now you can see skins of all online players
- “Players List”: now you can see all past messages of the online players
- “Players List”: all player names are sorted alphabetically now for easier searching

- Improved Map Search functionality for Multiplayer Mode

- Fixed large UI control buttons on the iPad devices

- Survival mode enhancements

- Added Iron Trapdoor Block

- Added Cell Door Block

- Added Wooden Trapdoor Block

- Added Fence Block

- User controls improvements

- Network and 3D rendering performance optimization

DON"T MISS THE NEW UPDATE! Be first to download and play new version of the game! We are waiting for your feedback and comments! 
---------------------
